title: Museum of History and Industry

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Beginning October 1, MOHAI will be open Thursday-Monday from 10 am-5 pm, and closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays. On the first Thursday of each month, MOHAI offers extended hours with free admission to the core exhibits from 5-8 pm. Three may be a crowd, but ten qualifies for group discounts at MOHAI. Bring your friends, family, colleagues, clients, or anyone you think may enjoy exploring Seattle history. More information on prices and parameters can be found below. All groups receiving discounted admission must visit together and pay admission in a single transaction at the time of entry or in advance.
